title: Adverbs of frequency
summary: Use frequency adverbs to say how often something happens.

explanation.en: Always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely and never show frequency. Their position depends on the verb.
explanation.ru: Always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely и never показывают частоту действия. Их место зависит от глагола.

examples.ru: Я обычно хожу в школу пешком.

examples.en: She is often tired after school.

commonMistakes.wrong: I go always to school by bus.
commonMistakes.right: I always go to school by bus.
commonMistakes.note: Put the adverb before most main verbs.
